entities.name: Sheki Historical and Local History Museum
entities.label: Institution
entities.summary: The Shaki Museum of History and Local Lore is a museum located in Sheki city of the Republic of Azerbaijan. The museum is named after the Azerbaijani pedagogue, writer and ethnographer Rashid Bey Efendiyev.
